prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a sideswipe while changing lanes. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1452; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: Right rear quarter panel shows scuffing and a deep scrape running along the lower edge of the door, with a dented rear fender bead and cracked taillight lens on the same side. The damage pattern lines up with a side contact during a lane change, and the paint transfer and scrape height are consistent with the reported impact. Repair plan calls for panel replacement, blend and refinish of the adjacent panels, and lens replacement. Labor hours are reasonable for the scope described. Invoices from the shop show a single set of charges with no duplicated line items. No prior damage to this vehicle is on record.
